0022600098.text: The Heat, 0-1 after their first game and 0-1 at home, host the 1-0 Detroit Pistons in Miami's second game of the 2026-27 season. Miami is fifth in the Southeast, one game back, and 15th in the East, while Detroit sits first in the Central and second in the East on a one-game winning streak. The teams have not met yet this season, but the Heat won the 2025-26 season series 2-1, including a 121-110 win in Miami on March 8, 2026.
